opus.name: Opus
opus.note: a core and plugins: each feature a file (.opmod) in /mods on the USB disk; a row naming a plugin (opus.NAME) is there only while its file is. Effect rows are added by name when the effect list first opens, and a row whose type neither the OS nor a loaded plugin knows is deleted then (op1r's too, unless the bridge runs that effect). Engines run in iter's slot. The bridge (opus.bridge, beside the starter pack) runs op1r's .op1p and Hundekraft's .knl files with their own names and op1r's numbers

unknown_names.effect: plays it as cwo, switched off; the sound itself is never rewritten. A second effect (Fx overdrive) of a type it doesn't know plays nothing and is written back as it was
